items.heading: Sarmale
details: Key ingredients: cabbage leaves, ground pork, rice, tomato
Mix ground pork with rice, onion and herbs.
Wrap portions of filling tightly in pickled cabbage leaves.
Layer the rolls in a pot with tomato sauce.
Simmer slowly for hours until tender and flavorful.

items.heading: Mamaliga Romaneasca
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, water, cheese, sour cream
Whisk corn meal into boiling salted water.
Stir continuously until it thickens into a smooth porridge.
Pour onto a board and let it firm up slightly.
Serve with crumbled cheese and sour cream.
